## Awards

**H.M. Kongens Gullmedalje — The King's Gold Medal** (2025)
Awarded for the PhD thesis *Approaches to Integrating Large Data into Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses in Education*.

**GEBF Junior Publication Prize** (2025)
Awarded by the Society for Empirical Educational Research (Gesellschaft für Empirische Bildungsforschung) for outstanding contributions to educational research.

**Most Engaged Master's Student Cohort 2017–2019**
Awarded by Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München.
